newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour decline to speculate on confidence vote.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour decline to speculate on confidence vote.

text.p: An aide to Labour leader Tony Blair on Monday declined to say whether the party might put down a motion of no confidence if the government is defeated in a key parliamentary vote on Monday night.
"We are playing our cards close to our chest," the aide said.
Labour hopes to defeat the government in a vote at 2200 gmt on its negotiating stance on the European Union's common fisheries policy, although the aide said victory is by no means certain.

The aide pointed out that Labour business manager Donald Dewar has repeatedly stated that he would only put down a confidence motion if he thought he could win it, forcing the government to call an early general election. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
